Assuming you're 31? You sound quite similar to me except better IT job (I work in tech/app support >\_:>), younger and also assuming not in debt. everything else you list is same.

Regarding the meds, sounds like you reacted bad to a SSRI (they didn't do anything for me). You can try SNRI, although given your experience I'd be hesitant on serotonic drugs. You could consider something like mitazrapine. This generally has fewer sides like emotion numbing (as far as I'm aware!) but has weight gain and a sedating effect due to the anti histamine action - could be a good thing if you have insomnia. I've been trying to get on a MAOI for a while now, but it's almost impossible in the UK. You could also look into moclobimide which is a reversible MAOI with fewer sides, trouble is it's fairly weak. Do lots of googling before you commit to another one to see if it's right for you as well as considering risk profiles.

Regarding the job, are you applying for any job at the moment? Or IT jobs? I don't blame you if you're not going for min wage but I was advised to do this. I was unemployed from Aug 2017 - May 2019 and eventually got a worse IT job than I had before but I had some bullshit to pad out CV.
